pages.text: $(li)$(thing)Warm-season:$() sow after the last frost, into warm soil. Sprouts after 70 °C·d above 10 °C.$(li)Ripens after $(thing)1250 °C·d$(). Best near 25 °C; stops above 35 °C.$(li)$(thing)Frost$() kills it below 0 °C (0.5 °C in flower).

$(li)$(thing)Soil pH$() 6-6.8 (tolerates 5.5-7.5). Roots 1 m. Dislikes waterlogging.$(li)$(thing)Feeds on$() N 150, P 25, K 250 kg/ha per crop.$(li)$(thing)Yield$() when well grown: about 27 tons/ac (60 t/ha).$(li)$(thing)Harvest:$() Tomato and Tomato Seeds. Regrows after cutting.
